reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The issuer will now more quickly retry when its linked Secret is updated to fix an issue that caused a high back-off timeout", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Issuers will now retry more quickly when their linked Secret is updated, reducing back-off timeout delays.

proposed.statement: Cert-manager issuers will now retry more quickly when their linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that caused high back-off timeout delays.
